import openpyxl

# Load workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

# Add SUMIF formulas in the specified cells only: H8:J8
# These formulas total the AMOUNT column (F) based on the selected PARTICULARS in column D,
# matching each category header in H5:J5.
for col in range(8, 11):  # H to J
    cell = ws.cell(row=8, column=col)
    header_cell = ws.cell(row=5, column=col).coordinate
    cell.value = f'=SUMIF($D:$D,{header_cell},$F:$F)'

# Save to required output path
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
